classification_evidence: * ''Spinning Axe'' deals the total increased damage in a single instance of {{WRtip|basic damage}}.
* ''Ranger's Focus'' first bolt deals {{WRtip|default damage|basic damage}} with the subsequent 4 bolts dealing a non-reactive damage type (e.g. {{WRtip|default damage}} or {{WRtip|proc
* The {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} dealt with the blade is {{WRtip|default damage}}. The flurry is first 1 instance of {{WRtip|basic damage}} and then 5
* Applies {{WRtip|spell damage}} on the shot and {{WRtip|area damage}} on the slash and explosives.
* ''Double Up'' deals {{WRtip|basic damage}} to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by dealing an additional 0 {{WRtip|spell damage}}.
* The first missile on a target applies {{WRtip|area damage}}, while the rest on the same target apply {{WRtip|persistent area damage}}.
* Applies {{WRtip|default damage}} for the burn, {{WRtip|spell damage}} and procs {{WRtip|basic damage}} required effects for the fireball, and {{WRtip|area damage}} for the explosions.
* Both weapons deal {{WRtip|basic damage}} to their primary target (this includes the increased damage of [[File:Jinx Switcheroo! WR.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Fishbones'').
* ''Mystic Shot'' deals {{WRtip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by dealing an additional 0 {{WRtip|spell damage}}.
* Applies {{WRtip|spell damage}} for the pulse and {{WRtip|area damage}} for the laser.
* Applies {{WRtip|area damage}} for the nova and {{WRtip|proc damage}} for the bounce.
